etymologies.etymologyHTML:
From Italian studio (“room for study”), from Latin studium.

Doublet of study and etude.

definitions.definition: An artist’s or photographer’s workshop or the room in which an artist works.
An establishment where an art is taught.
A place where radio or television programs, records or films are made.

quote.citation: 2022, Bonnie Garmus, Lessons in Chemistry, Penguin (2023), page 285:
quote.text: The studio was dark and cool, with thick cords running from one end to the other and huge cameras on either side, each primed to swivel and record what the lights from above illuminated.

definitions.definition: A company or organization that makes films, records or other artistic works.
